channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: New TrustLink Coax Connector Engineered for High-Integrity Connectivity Solutions
item.description: High-integrity signal transmission is mission-critical in subsea operations, whether for HD video, radar, or telemetry. MacArtney’s new TrustLink™ Coax connector delivers this capability through precision impedance matching in a compact, rugged design that ensures stable, low-loss connections for demanding environments.

item.title: EnerMech Appoints LNG Expert to Lead Its Global Infrastructure and Industrial Solutions Team
item.description: EnerMech has appointed LNG industry leader Vasant Saith as Senior Vice President of its Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions (I&I) global business line, strengthening the company’s leadership team as it accelerates growth in North America and beyond.

item.title: MARSS Successfully Completes ISO 21195 Phase 3 Testing for MOBtronic Man-Overboard Detection System
item.description: MARSS has successfully completed Phase 3 testing of the ISO 21195 standard for man-overboard (MOB) detection systems—a rigorous, internationally recognized benchmark, designed to verify real-world performance and reliability on operating vessels. This milestone further establishes MARSS’ MOBtronic solution as the leading system proven to meet ISO requirements through real-world on-ship testing.

item.title: BOEM Publishes Final Notice of Sale for Cook Inlet Lease Sale
item.description: As part of a broader effort to unleash American energy by encouraging oil and gas exploration and production on federal lands and waters, the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management announced the Final Notice of Sale for the Cook Inlet Outer Continental Shelf Oil and Gas Lease Sale 1. Officially authorized under the “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” and commonly known as BBC1, this marks the first of six lease sales in Alaska’s Cook Inlet required by the legislation.

item.title: Terma and Lithuanian Wind Power Association Sign MoU to Advance Wind Energy While Safeguarding National Security
item.description: Terma and the Lithuanian Wind Power Association (Lvea) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore opportunities for wind energy development in Lithuania while upholding national defense requirements through the use of advanced monitoring and radar technologies.

item.title: Subsea7 Lands Monopile Transportation and Installation Contract Offshore Germany
item.description: Subsea7 announced the award to Seaway7, part of the Subsea7 Group, of a substantial contract by OWP Gennaker, part of Skyborn Renewables, for the Gennaker offshore wind farm in Germany.

item.title: Subsea7 Awarded Shell Kaikias Waterflood Project Contract
item.description: Subsea7 announced the award of a sizeable contract by Shell for the Kaikias Waterflood project. The Kaikias field is a deepwater development in the Mars-Ursa Basin, approximately 210 kilometers off the Louisiana coast in the US.

item.title: Minesto Accelerates Market Development in Taiwan Through Swedish Energy Agency’s Global Innovation Accelerator Program
item.description: Minesto, a leading ocean energy developer, has been awarded a 24,000 EUR grant from the Swedish Energy Agency (SEA) through the Global Innovation Accelerator (GIA) program, aiming to accelerate the company’s market development in Taiwan. As part of the program, Minesto officially took part in the high-level Nordic-Taiwan Sustainable Energy Forum, held in Taipei in December.

item.title: Mozambique LNG Announces the Full Restart of All Its Activities Onshore and Offshore in Mozambique
item.description: Patrick Pouyanné, Chairman and CEO of TotalEnergies, met in Afungi with His Excellency Daniel Chapo, President of the Republic of Mozambique, and announced together the full restart of Mozambique LNG project activities.

item.title: New Abyssal Fishing Worm Discovered
item.description: An intriguing new species of deep-sea worm, Melinnopsis nathanieli, has been described from the dark, cold depths of the NE Atlantic, southwest of Ireland.
